arguments.conflicts: CM-A (600@900) vs CM-BIG (2000@800) - both signed and unexpired; CM-BIG offers better pricing for committed volume
arguments.reason: Deeper signed commitment exists: CM-BIG commits 2000 units at tier price 800, but current pricing reflects shallower CM-A commitment of 600 units at 900. Per instructions, must price genuinely deeper commitment if available.
